actual_tool_job.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Return one corrected complete portrait card. Image1 exact rejected full-resolution editing target; Image2 unchanged original small card controls exact primary IMAGE-LEFT pose/roll, hair, moustache, clothes, crop and light; Image3 user mascot identity and compact round anatomy only. Correct ONLY elongated lower yellow face and collar contact. Current lower face below closed mouth is too long and narrows to a downward point above the blue bow. Shorten that lower segment into a BROAD ROUNDED SHORT U base close below mouth, forming ONE COMPACT NEAR-ROUND HEAD, not a long egg-shaped human jaw or triangular V. Raise/broaden existing white shirt neckline around this rounded base with coherent front/rear collar overlap/contact shadow, minimal very short broad neck transition. Keep exact IMAGE-LEFT three-quarter angle and original head roll; do not rotate frontal to hide the issue. Preserve actual BROWN WAVY swept-back side-part hair and real eyebrow HAIR, narrow DARK upper-lip moustache/clean chin and serious CLOSED mouth. Keep actual OPEN NAVY/BLACK suit, PALE shirt and BLUE SHORT BOW with lateral fabric wings, not long tie or cravat. No new accessories, pinched neckline, yellow shaft, neck rolls, floating/clipping fabric, cream bib or invented teeth. Preserve complete tilted rim, OPAQUE BLUE/GREY photo backing and original cream note overlap. All solid interiors opaque, genuine alpha only outside actual whole card. Fine hair/bow/note detail understated, no invented readable text.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
